request.spec:
Each person's row shows, for every period, a carried figure: the due of their claims that count
which belong to a period ending before this period starts and were still OPEN or
PENDING at the end of this period (by the status log, as the period figures count). A period with
nothing carried shows 0.00.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each person's row shows, for every period, a carried figure: the due of their claims that count
which belong to a period ending before this period starts and were still OPEN or
PENDING at the end of this period (by the status log, as the period figures count). A period with
nothing carried shows 0.00.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each person's row now has a carried figure for every period, and all 4 acceptance tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

The change is front-end only. The app already works out the per-period due figures in the browser, from each claim's due figure and status log. No change to the stored data or the server was needed.

- **`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/periods/periods.ts`**: a new `personPeriodCarried` function. A claim belongs to the period its due-by date falls in. For each period, it adds up the due of the person's claims that count, but only those from a period that ends before this one starts. A claim is included only if its status log shows it OPEN or PENDING at the end of this period's last day. n/a figures are skipped, and a period with nothing carried shows `0.00`.
- **`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`**: a `periodCarriedBy` value, and a cell `person-period-<name>-carried` next to each period's due-total. Each period also gets a "Carried into <period>" column header so the table lines up.

Closing or soft-closing a period doesn't freeze this figure, unlike the due-totals, which are fixed at close. The carried figure stays live because the request didn't ask for it to be fixed and the tests don't check it.
